faq.subtitle: Everything jewellers usually ask before placing their first bulk order with us.

items.q: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.a: MOQs vary by box type and customisation level — typically starting from 100–500 pieces for standard designs. Share your requirement on WhatsApp and we'll confirm the exact MOQ and slab pricing upfront.

items.q: Can you print or emboss our jewellery brand logo?
items.a: Yes. We offer foil stamping, embossing, debossing and full-colour printing of your logo, monogram or artwork in your brand colours. Send us your logo file to receive design mockups before production.

items.q: Where do you deliver, and what are the timelines?
items.a: We ship across India directly from our Hyderabad factory. Standard production takes 7–15 working days depending on quantity and customisation, plus transit time. Express options are available for urgent orders.

items.q: What materials and finishes do you work with?
items.a: Rigid paper board, leatherette, velvet, satin and foam inserts. Every interior is engineered to cradle delicate pieces — rings, necklaces, bangles and heavy bridal sets — without scratching.

items.q: Can we see samples before confirming a bulk order?
items.a: Absolutely. We can produce a pre-production sample of your custom design so you can check size, material and finish. Sample cost is adjusted against your bulk order confirmation.

items.q: Do you provide GST invoices for business purchases?
items.a: Yes — we are fully GST registered (GSTIN: 36AFMPN3258E1ZB) and issue proper tax invoices for every B2B order, suitable for your accounting and procurement records.

items.q: How do I get a quotation?
items.a: Use the enquiry form above or message us on WhatsApp at +91 93467 97060 with your box types, quantities and branding needs — you'll receive pricing, MOQ and delivery estimates, usually the same day.
